name: X
description: Trigger workflows from new mentions or posts matching a search on X, and create, reply to, delete, read and search posts from a step.

triggers.label: New mention
triggers.description: A post mentions the connected account. Polls the mentions timeline with since_id; a burst above 100 mentions between polls loses the oldest. Access: 300 requests per 15 minutes per user, billed per post read (an Owned Read when the account owns the app). Metered per request and per post read; see the README for the price and the rate limit of each call.

env.name: X_API_KEY
env.description: The app's API Key (OAuth 1.0a consumer key).
env.builderHint: https://developer.x.com/en/portal/dashboard: Projects & Apps, the app, Keys and tokens. Shown once at creation; regenerate from the same tab.

env.name: X_API_SECRET
env.description: The app's API Key Secret (consumer secret).
env.builderHint: Same tab as the API key; half of the HMAC-SHA1 signing key.

env.name: X_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: The Access Token generated for your own account under Keys and tokens.
env.builderHint: Set the app permission to Read and Write before generating it: a token made earlier stays read-only.

env.name: X_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET
env.description: The Access Token Secret shown with the access token.
env.builderHint: Regenerated together with the access token; the other half of the signing key.

env.name: X_SEARCH_QUERY
env.description: Recent-search query the "new search result" trigger polls, such as `from:xdevelopers -is:retweet`.
env.builderHint: Only needed by newSearchResult; 1 to 512 characters of recent-search syntax, last 7 days only.

triggers.label: New search result
triggers.description: A post from the last 7 days matches the search query with since_id; a burst above 100 matches between polls loses the oldest. Access: 300 requests per 15 minutes per user, billed per post returned; recent search is the read that used to need a paid tier. Metered per request and per post read; see the README for the price and the rate limit of each call.

env.builderHint: https://developer.x.com/en/portal/dashboard: Projects & Apps, the app, Keys and tokens. Shown once at creation; regenerate from the same tab.

env.builderHint: Set the app permission to Read and Write before generating it: a token made earlier stays read-only.

env.builderHint: Only needed by newSearchResult; 1 to 512 characters of recent-search syntax, last 7 days only.

actions.label: Create post
actions.description: Publish a post of up to 280 characters, optionally as a reply or a quote. Needs Read and Write permission.

inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The post, up to 280 characters for non-Premium accounts.
inputs.builderHint: Counted in code points before sending; the API may still weigh a text longer and answer 403.

inputs.label: In reply to post id
inputs.description: Id of the post to reply to, sent as reply.in_reply_to_tweet_id.

inputs.label: Quote post id
inputs.description: Id of the post to quote, sent as quote_tweet_id; the docs say quoting needs an Enterprise plan.

outputs.description: The text as X stored it

actions.label: Reply to post
actions.description: Reply to a post with up to 280 characters. Needs Read and Write permission.

inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The reply, up to 280 characters for non-Premium accounts.

outputs.description: The text as X stored it

actions.label: Delete post
actions.description: Delete one of the connected account's own posts. Needs Read and Write permission.

outputs.description: Whether X reports the post deleted

actions.label: Get me
actions.description: The connected account. Access: 75 requests per 15 minutes per user, one user read. Metered per request and per post read; see the README for the price and the rate limit of each call.

actions.label: Get post
actions.description: A post by id with its author and public metrics. Access: 900 requests per 15 minutes per user, one post read plus one user read. Metered per request and per post read; see the README for the price and the rate limit of each call.

outputs.description: public_metrics as JSON: like, reply, repost, quote, bookmark and impression counts

actions.label: Get user by username
actions.description: A user by handle. Access: 900 requests per 15 minutes per user, one user read. Metered per request and per post read; see the README for the price and the rate limit of each call.

inputs.label: Username
inputs.description: The handle without @ (1 to 15 letters, digits or underscores); a leading @ is stripped.

actions.label: Search recent posts
actions.description: Posts from the last 7 days matching a query, newest first. Access: 300 requests per 15 minutes per user, billed per post returned; this is the read that used to need a paid tier. Metered per request and per post read; see the README for the price and the rate limit of each call.

inputs.label: Query
inputs.description: Recent-search query, 1 to 512 characters, such as from:xdevelopers -is:retweet.

inputs.label: Max results
inputs.description: 10 to 100, default 10; a smaller value is raised to 10.

inputs.label: Since id
inputs.description: Only posts with an id greater than this one.

outputs.description: JSON array of posts: id, text, createdAt, conversationId, inReplyToUserId, author, url
